One-off browser verification script is deployment-scoped; reusable badge/cart checks are retained in procedural skills, but no standalone generic browser harness has been validated.

Portable stages, create-once, publication gates and uncertain-write recovery are implemented. Native research/image/message tool bridges, site-specific SEO REST registration and full tracker orchestration are not wired as a fresh deployment.

Explicit date parser, durable outbox and six-position product/template assignment are implemented. Authenticated inbound schedule challenge/confirmation bridge and daemon admission wiring remain unported.
Supporting test/package/deployment-utility records, not additional standalone skills; retained in record accounting rather than reimplemented individually.

Photo operations accept explicit credentials and token-provider callback. The original OAuth callback/refresh helper is bound to private application setup and is not redistributed or activated; use your own reviewed OAuth integration.

FB/IG adapter, TikTok adapter and durable approval/revocation are implemented. The original multi-platform Engine worker, exact visual/asset binding and autonomous recovery dispatcher still require a portable integrated harness.

Durable claim/receipt/no-replay logic and owner report outbox are implemented. The original native message-tool/owner-route bridge is not packaged as an authenticated transport; callbacks must use an independently authorized sender.

Original WooCommerce mutation adapters use site-specific WP-CLI grants and source-schema mappings. The generic WordPress client and catalog procedural skill do not replace the full isolated Woo setter/backup/derived-field test environment, which is not available in this release.

Task lifecycle, stalls, endpoint health and inquiry failure reader are implemented. Native runtime-event ingestion and production-specific result watchers/delivery daemon remain outside the standalone adapter.

Capped start/collection and independent policy/credit guards are implemented and mocked. Original scheduled owner evidence-monitor routing is not ported; account history beyond the bounded 30-run window is deliberately blocked pending tested pagination.

Original canonical draft controller writes production Sheets and invokes host-owned image/preview tools. No safely configured standalone creation/revision/delivery entry point has passed isolated adapter tests.

Original rendering code depends on supplied branded logo/QR/photo assets, six layout-specific font/QR contracts, Playwright and exact-artifact visual review. These dependencies were inspected; no complete brand-neutral renderer/assets package with independent QA is validated. Rotation alone is not six rendered templates.

Receipt-bound three-image validation/recovery is implemented. Provider-task capture/replay bridge and original marker/crop quality reviewer depend on host-owned task and artifact contracts not ported.

Overture acquisition, conversion, qualification, dedup and approved Google lead merge/readback are implemented. Original verified-site/geography-specific enrichment and weekly notification orchestration are not generalized.
Original language behavior is ported and regression-tested.

Authenticated REST read/update/media functionality is provided by the portable WordPress client; production-bound shell invocation and credentials are intentionally not copied. Live account integration is NOT TESTED.
Generic GOG lead synchronization is implemented. The original multi-tab SEO tracker adapter/schema and process-bound coordination remain separate unported integration work.

Keyword/brief/local metadata/content-review helpers are implemented. The original Elementor command-plan wrapper is not an executable browser integration; external agent-browser dependency and live Elementor flow remain unvalidated.
Original public knowledge refresher is generalized, fixture-tested and documented with its first-page-only limit. Its production timer/account deployment is not activated.
